title: Reese's Sodium Options
body:
Reese's Sodium Options replaces Sodium's options screen with an alternate layout and styling focused on a compact, navigable configuration experience.

Modern Sodium already provides a full configuration screen and public options API. RSO is mainly an alternative frontend for users who prefer its tab layout, grouped presentation, styling, and extra quality-of-life controls.

# Features

- Alternative Sodium options screen layout and styling.
- Search bar for quickly finding options.
- Scrollable vertical tab list and option pages.
- Collapsible mod tab groups with configurable behavior.
- Collapsible option groups within pages.
- Customizable tab headers, including icons and version labels.
- Configurable tooltip delay and optional option ID display.
- Focused option tooltips for keyboard/controller navigation.
- Optional color themes for option pages and controls.
- Per-option reset-to-default overlay.
- Per-option undo overlay for modified options.
- `SHIFT` + scroll slider adjustments.
- Optional reverse cycling controls.
- Improved keyboard navigation.
- UI narration support.
- Optional Controlify support for controller navigation and button guides.
- Option to disable RSO and return to Sodium's default options screen.

# Requirements

- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)

# Optional Integrations

- [Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify) for controller navigation support.

# Notes

RSO is a client-side UI replacement for Sodium's options screen. It is not required for Sodium configuration, and it is intended for users who prefer RSO's layout, styling, and quality-of-life behavior.

Sodium Options API is no longer supported on versions where Sodium already provides the relevant options API directly.

#### Please do not ask CaffeineMC for support with this mod. Reese's Sodium Options has no affiliation with CaffeineMC.
